notes.title: Fix for pixel artifacts on integrated AMD GPUs
notes.content:
A new update is out that fixes the diagonal pixel artifacts on integrated AMD GPUs.

Here is a screenshot of the observed artifacts before this patch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45291684/dbfecfc40ed7ac1d6f8abce22a41666aa816ab8a.png[/img]

It has confirmed by one of the play testers that these artifacts do not appear after this patch.

notes.title: Fixes for integrated AMD GPUs
notes.content: - this should address pixels artifacts that seem to occur only on integrated AMD GPUs but more testing is necessary as I personally don't own and AMD platform

notes.title: Improved logging when rejecting a GPU device
notes.content: - added logic to handle systems where only integrated GPUs are present; additional logs are captured when a GPU is rejected due to missing features or extensions
